subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de adição e de subtração, envolvendo números de até três ordens, com os significados de juntar, acrescentar, separar, retirar, utilizando estratégias pessoais ou convencionais.

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de adição com números até três dígitos usando estratégias pessoais ou convencionais
components.description_en: Solve addition problems with numbers up to three digits using personal or conventional strategies

components.description_pt: Compor problemas de adição e subtração com números até três dígitos com significados variados
components.description_en: Compose addition and subtraction problems with numbers up to three digits with varied meanings
components.cc_component_description: Use drawings or equations with a symbol for the unknown number to represent addition and subtraction problems within 100

components.description_pt: Identificar o significado (juntar, acrescentar, separar, tirar) em um problema de adição ou subtração
components.description_en: Identify the meaning (joining, adding to, separating, taking from) in a given addition or subtraction problem
components.cc_component_description: Use addition and subtraction within 100 to solve two-step word problems involving situations of adding to, taking from, putting together, taking apart, and comparing, with unknowns in all positions

cc_matches.description: Use addition and subtraction within 100 to solve one- and two-step word problems involving situations of adding to, taking from, putting together, taking apart, and comparing, with unknowns in all positions, e.g., by using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number to represent the problem.
Solve addition and subtraction word problems, and add and subtract within 10, e.g., by using objects or drawings to represent the problem.
